verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions TPU, Gaudi, or any specialized-accelerator backend. Documented hardware detection covers only NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs. The `--external-grpc-backends` flag is a generic plugin mechanism, a developer building block that could be used to build such support, not evidence that LocalAI ships it, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
